svg.aria-label: Big O chooses one positive constant; little o chooses a threshold for each positive epsilon. Both cover all subsequent n.
svg.title: Quantifiers in O and little o
svg.desc: Big O chooses one positive constant; little o chooses a threshold for each positive epsilon. Both cover all subsequent n.

g.text: Quantifier order controls the strength of a bound
Fix one factor covering every sufficiently large input
For every positive factor, choose a sufficient threshold
